question: Do two existing physical support statistics provide identity evidence beyond the three frozen score terms? Diagnose the proposed reliability gate on the sealed ordinary cohort without training it.
cohort: All 18,620 ordinary Validation direction records. Six directions equal in macro metrics. Target ground truth only after sealing all choices. Previously exposed records, all fallbacks and harms retained. No FINAL, source training or target adaptation.
support: At the second decoder read take visible attention mass and minus the size-normalized support centroid offset, from the subject's own slot. A larger value favors retaining that slot in both coordinates. Object-specific confidence and identity are not assumed equivalent.
diagnostic: Among wrong decisions with a passing slot, partition into the primary score terms' weak coordinatewise dominance obstruction and the subset where genuine physical statistics remove it. Compare all nine within-slate derangements, moving the two physical values together. Label-dependent removal is an oracle capacity diagnostic for any shared isotone score and does not establish a deployable gain.
decision: For every input, list challengers whose visible mass and minus center offset are both strictly greater than the v1 winner's. Switch to the challenger with the largest original final score, keeping native tie order; if none, retain v1. Identical operation for each derangement. No training, threshold or tie-policy optimization. Labels unavailable during decisions.
comparisons: Report the frozen baseline, true assignment, equal mean and range of nine derangements, six directions, strict oriented IoU >0.25 / >0.50, paired rescues/harm, and paired recording bootstrap. Derangements are alternatives on the same inputs, never pooled as independent samples.
